data.cultural_impact: The name Bethuel was borne by an important figure in the Old Testament, the father of Rachel's children. This name has been associated with a strong sense of familial and religious identity in Jewish culture. It serves as a reminder of the importance of God in the foundation and continuity of family lineage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bethuel holds deep spiritual significance for Christians. It is a constant reminder of the importance of making our homes a dwelling place for God. Just as the name suggests, 'house of God', every Christian home should be a beacon of God's love and presence. It is a call to dedicate our homes to God and to live our lives in accordance with His will.
